Load dose calculation parameters

load_params.Rd

Loads default parameters or parameters from external source and returns them as a nested list.

Usage

load_params(path = NULL, sar_path = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path of parameter file to load (must be a YAML file). If null, default non-SAR parameters are loaded. The file may contain SAR values or not.

sar_path

SAR values (optional): the name of a SAR file included in the package (see available_sar_files(): "goliat_average", "goliat_duke", "goliat_ella", "goliat_eartha", "goliat_thelonious" or "etain"), or the path of a YAML file with SAR values, with the structure devices > device > tissue > SAR values. Its values replace those of the parameters loaded from path. Besides SAR values, it may set device parameters that go with them (e.g. placement proportions such as legs_prop).

Value

List of parameters loaded from yaml input file(s)

Details

Default parameters are split in two files: non-SAR parameters (params.yaml) and SAR values, which are merged into a single list. The default SAR values are those of GOLIAT, averaged over four phantoms ("goliat_average"). The ETAIN SAR values are "etain".

SAR values are taken from sar_path if given. Otherwise, the SAR values of the parameter file are used, or the default SAR values if the parameter file has none. A SAR file may also set device parameters that go with its SAR values (e.g. placement proportions), which replace those of the parameter file.

See also

load_tissue_params(), available_sar_files()

Examples

params <- load_params()
params <- load_params(sar_path = "goliat_average") # the same, with the SAR file named
